description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useGestureWS' that manages a WebSocket connection to a gesture server, handles gesture message parsing, debouncing, coalescing, and exposes gesture state and connection status for use within React components.

methods.name: useGestureWS({ enabledDefault = true, debounceMs = 60 } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that connects to a gesture WebSocket server, manages connection lifecycle, message normalization, debouncing, and exposes gesture-related state and controls.
